title: H1.22 base-agent task-complexity diagnostic
scientific_question: 在同一 fashion WebShop 任务族、同一冻结 Qwen2.5-3B 与同一交互接口下，任务约束复杂度是否解释 H1.21 的全零闭环结果？
hypothesis: 若复杂任务约束超出 base-agent 在当前接口下的可用范围，则 simple complexity=3 的任务应比 complex complexity=10 有更高的 qualified-positive rate、buy-action rate 或 task score；若两组都接近零，则支持更广泛的 base-agent/interface bottleneck。
claim_boundary: This is a frozen-base capability diagnostic, not a Q3 learning experiment. It cannot establish OpenEvo efficacy, training transfer, H2, D0, retention, forward transfer, or SEED comparison.
complexity_definition: attribute_count + option_count + price_constraint; category=fashion; simple=3; complex=10

budget.gpu_policy: one task per cell; all eight verified idle RTX 5090 UUIDs required

stop_rule: Do not sweep prompts, horizons, ranks, LR, epochs, carriers, or model sizes after this group. Stop and reconcile after the preregistered 32 attempts; parser/runtime failures remain separate from the scientific denominator.
positive_branch: A simple-group selective advantage is descriptive capability evidence only; do not open Q3. A later learning question would require a new preregistration.
negative_branch: If both groups are near zero or the contrast is absent, record base-agent/interface/task-family usability bottleneck and release GPUs; do not invent another adapter variant.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after online initialization/upload failure with exact error and spool hash
